DOES NOT WATCH CART

Doesn't really go that far, still worth keeping up if possible
Passive option (place on window so your team can see it)

2R.d:
Best spot for C

super early hold for C

likely to get spammed out

0B.d: Early placement to avoid bombardment by mid
helps team peek out enemy sentries on A

1B.d: furthest back the exit should be

take this side ASAP, pushing through backyard is critical
